items.title: YMYL financial content lacks sufficient expertise demonstration

items.title: Affiliate disclosure prominence needs 2024 FTC compliance enhancement
items.description: While affiliate links use proper rel attributes and site has disclosure, the FTC has increased enforcement of prominent, clear disclosures that appear before affiliate content and are easily understood by consumers.

Use clear language like 'This post contains affiliate links to AgedLeadStore.com, which means we earn a commission if you make a purchase.' Ensure disclosures are mobile-friendly and above-the-fold.

items.title: Core Web Vitals optimization needed for INP transition
items.description: Google is replacing FID with INP (Interaction to Next Paint) in March 2024, requiring focus on interaction responsiveness. Next.js/Vercel stack should perform well, but affiliate tracking and content loading may impact metrics.
items.recommendation: Audit Core Web Vitals with focus on INP metrics. Optimize affiliate link tracking in lib/affiliate.ts for minimal performance impact. Implement lazy loading for non-critical content, optimize images with Next.js Image component, and minimize JavaScript bundle size. Monitor real user metrics via Vercel Analytics.
